input_messages.content:
Hi! I actually need help with a couple of things. I recently moved to a new house, but it’s still on Elm Avenue here in Houston. I noticed that one of my recent orders was sent to my old address instead of the new one, and I’d like to get that fixed. Also, can you update my default address in your system to the new house? I’d prefer not to share my address again since it should be in my order history. 

And one more thing—I’d like to exchange my tablet for the most affordable model you have, since moving has been a bit expensive. Can you help me with all of this?
Sure, my email is sophia.martin4832@example.com. Let me know if you need anything else to verify my account!

For the address, I’d really prefer not to share it again since both my old and new addresses are on Elm Avenue and should be visible in my order history. Could you please look them up there and update my default to the new one? 

As for the tablet, it’s the most recent one I ordered—should be easy to spot in my account. I’d like to exchange that for the cheapest tablet you have. Let me know if you need anything else from me!

Yes, please update my default address to 760 Elm Avenue, Suite 564—that’s my new place.

And yes, if it’s possible, I’d like to modify my pending order (#W1603792) to swap the tablet for the cheapest one you have. Please let me know the details and any price difference before you make the change.

That all sounds perfect! Please go ahead and update my default address to 760 Elm Avenue, Suite 564, and swap the tablet in my pending order for the 7-inch, 128GB, black model. I’m good with the refund as well. Thanks for your help!

That’s great, thank you so much for taking care of everything! I don’t need anything else right now. Have a wonderful day! 

###STOP###
